{"CommandLine":"python -c "import ctypes, struct
k32 = ctypes.windll.kernel32
h = k32.OpenProcess(0x1F0FFF, False, 35116)
mbi = ctypes.create_string_buffer(48)
val_double = struct.pack('<d', 1049999.0)
val_i64 = struct.pack('<q', 1049999)
addr = 0
matches_d = []
matches_i64 = []
while addr < 0x7FFFFFFFFFFF:
    ret = k32.VirtualQueryEx(h, ctypes.c_void_p(addr), mbi, 48)
    if ret == 0:
        addr += 0x10000
        continue
    base = struct.unpack('<Q', mbi.raw[0:8])[0]
    size = struct.unpack('<Q', mbi.raw[24:32])[0]
    state = struct.unpack('<I', mbi.raw[32:36])[0]
    protect = struct.unpack('<I', mbi.raw[36:40])[0]
    next_addr = base + size
    if next_addr <= addr:
        addr += 0x10000
        continue
    if state == 0x1000 and (protect & (0x04 | 0x08 | 0x40 | 0x80)) and not (protect & (0x100 | 0x01)):
        buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(size)
        bytes_read = ctypes.c_size_t(0)
        if k32.ReadProcessMemory(h, ctypes.c_void_p(base), buf, size, ctypes.byref(bytes_read)):
            raw = buf.raw[:bytes_read.value]
            idx = 0
            while True:
                idx = raw.find(val_double, idx)
                if idx == -1: break
                matches_d.append(hex(base + idx))
                idx += 8
            idx = 0
            while True:
                idx = raw.find(val_i64, idx)
                if idx == -1: break
                matches_i64.append(hex(base + idx))
                idx += 8
    addr = next_addr
print(f'Double matches: {len(matches_d)}:', matches_d[:8])
print(f'Int64 matches: {len(matches_i64)}:', matches_i64[:8])
k32.CloseHandle(h)
